boundary.description: From the junction of Colliers Row Road and Smithills Dean Road, S along Smithills Dean Road to the point where Smithills Dean Road meets Dean Brook, E by the Dean Brook, Astley Brook, to the point opposite Chapelfield Street, by Chapelfield Street and by a beeline to and along Wolfenden Street, then E along Halliwell Road, Kay Street, Topp Way, Higher Bridge Street, Prince Street, Merehall Drive, Gaskell Street, and W along Chorley Old Road (B6226) to its junction with Shepherd Cross Street and by a bee-line SW to and along Victory Street, Beverly Road, Dobson Road. Then E along Gilnow Road and S by a bee-line to the railway including both sides of Gilnow Gardens in St Thomas of Canterbury parish. E along the railway, past Lostock station and by a bee-line to the footpath leading to Regent Road (including all of Overdene and Morris Fold Drive estate). Then N along Regent Road, W along Chorley New Road, and by a bee-line to Chorley Old Road (including both sides of Princess Road and the Kilphin). E along Chorley Old Road, N along Walker Fold Road, Colliers Row Road to its junction with Smithills Dean Road.
